name: Densest Subgraph (twice) of Tagged Singletons
proof: The $1$-inclusion graph is a tree with $n+\lceil\log n\rceil+1$ vertices.  Every subgraph is a forest, so a subgraph on $v$ vertices has average degree at most $2(v-1)/v$, which increases with $v$.  The full tree attains this bound, so it is a densest subgraph and has the stated double density.
